_source: Eurostat demo_r_pjangrp3 NUTS 2 (2022); GISCO NUTS_RG_10M_2021; GeoNames cities15000; Eurostat nama_10r_2gdp, lfst_r_lfu3rt and nama_10r_3gva (2022); regional GDP is the population-share proxy -- no NUTS region exists for it -- Natural Earth admin-1 geometry, official or GeoNames regional population shares of the World Bank total; branch GVA is absent for the country, so every region carries the nation's own World Bank sector shares; natural change is the national World Bank crude rate, -0.536 %/yr, in every region -- no regional rate exists, so every region carries the national World Bank crude birth minus death rate
_note: Generated by tools/import_data.py -- every field here is dataset-derived and a re-import overwrites the file whole. `share` is of the NATION for a region and of its own REGION for a city; both sums are below 1.0 and the remainder is the unnamed residual -- extra-regio and overseas at the national level, rural and small towns at the regional one. `gdp_share` is of the NATION's GDP and its residual is extra-regio; `unemployment_rel` is the region's rate over the nation's, normalised so the population-weighted mean is exactly 1.0; `sector_mix` sums to exactly 1.0; `natural_change_pct` is the region's crude rate of births minus deaths, per cent per year, signed, window-averaged over the years named in _source -- the mean over live shares is taken in the sim, not here. See docs/geography-model.md, docs/region-economy-model.md and docs/natural-change-model.md.
